WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) as month,
    SUM(totals.totalTransactionRevenue) as monthly_revenue
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20171231'
    AND totals.totalTransactionRevenue IS NOT NULL
    AND trafficSource.source = '(direct)'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT 
  '(direct)' as traffic_source,
  ROUND(MAX(monthly_revenue) - MIN(monthly_revenue), 2) / 1000000 as diff_millions
FROM monthly

WITH 
-- First, find the top traffic source by total product revenue
top_source AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS total_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source
  ORDER BY total_product_revenue_millions DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
-- Daily revenue per traffic source
daily_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    date,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS daily_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source, date
),
-- Weekly revenue per traffic source
weekly_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS weekly_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source, week_start
),
-- Monthly revenue per traffic source
monthly_rev AS (
  SELECT 
    trafficSource.source AS traffic_source,
    DATE_TRUNC(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', date), MONTH) AS month_start,
    SUM(SAFE_CAST(p.productRevenue AS FLOAT64)) / 1000000 AS monthly_product_revenue_millions
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`,
    UNNEST(hits) AS h, 
    UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20170101' AND '20170630'
    AND p.productRevenue IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY traffic_source, month_start
)
SELECT 
  ts.traffic_source,
  (SELECT MAX(d.daily_product_revenue_millions) FROM daily_rev d WHERE d.traffic_source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_daily_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(w.weekly_product_revenue_millions) FROM weekly_rev w WHERE w.traffic_source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_weekly_product_revenue_millions,
  (SELECT MAX(m.monthly_product_revenue_millions) FROM monthly_rev m WHERE m.traffic_source = ts.traffic_source) AS max_monthly_product_revenue_millions
FROM top_source ts

WITH first_visit AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    MIN(date) AS first_visit_date
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
  GROUP BY fullVisitorId
),
first_txn_session AS (
  SELECT 
    fullVisitorId,
    date,
    device.deviceCategory,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY fullVisitorId ORDER BY date ASC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
    AND totals.transactions IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  fv.fullVisitorId
FROM first_visit fv
JOIN first_txn_session fts ON fv.fullVisitorId = fts.fullVisitorId AND fts.rn = 1
WHERE fts.deviceCategory = 'mobile'
  AND fts.date > fv.first_visit_date
ORDER BY fv.fullVisitorId

SELECT state, drug_name, total_claims
FROM (
  SELECT 
    nppes_provider_state AS state,
    drug_name,
    SUM(total_claim_count) AS total_claims,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nppes_provider_state ORDER BY SUM(total_claim_count) DESC) AS rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.cms_medicare.part_d_prescriber_2014`
  WHERE nppes_provider_state IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY nppes_provider_state, drug_name
)
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY state

WITH all_storms AS (
  SELECT '1980' as year, state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1980`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1981', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1981`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1982', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1982`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1983', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1983`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1984', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1984`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1985', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1985`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1986', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1986`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1987', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1987`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1988', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1988`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1989', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1989`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1990', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1990`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1991', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1991`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1992', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1992`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1993', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1993`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1994', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1994`
  UNION ALL SELECT '1995', state, state_fips_code FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_historic_severe_storms.storms_1995`
),
per_year_counts AS (
  SELECT year, state, state_fips_code, COUNT(*) as event_count
  FROM all_storms
  GROUP BY year, state, state_fips_code
),
top_1000_per_year AS (
  SELECT year, state, state_fips_code, event_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY event_count DESC) as rn
  FROM per_year_counts
)
SELECT state, state_fips_code, SUM(event_count) as total_events
FROM top_1000_per_year
WHERE rn <= 1000
GROUP BY state, state_fips_code
ORDER BY total_events DESC
LIMIT 5

WITH wa_2023 AS (
  SELECT 
    s.usaf AS station_id,
    s.name,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2023
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2023` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE s.state = 'WA'
    AND g.prcp > 0 
    AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY s.usaf, s.name
),
wa_2022 AS (
  SELECT 
    s.usaf AS station_id,
    COUNT(*) AS rainy_days_2022
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022` g
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.stations` s ON g.stn = s.usaf AND g.wban = s.wban
  WHERE s.state = 'WA'
    AND g.prcp > 0 
    AND g.prcp != 99.99
  GROUP BY s.usaf
)
SELECT 
  w23.station_id,
  w23.name,
  w23.rainy_days_2023,
  w22.rainy_days_2022
FROM wa_2023 w23
JOIN wa_2022 w22 ON w23.station_id = w22.station_id
WHERE w23.rainy_days_2023 > 150
  AND w23.rainy_days_2023 < w22.rainy_days_2022
ORDER BY w23.rainy_days_2023 DESC

WITH daily_prcp AS (
  SELECT 
    date,
    SUM(value) / 10.0 as precipitation_mm
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_2016`
  WHERE id = 'US1NYKN0025'
    AND element = 'PRCP'
    AND (qflag IS NULL OR qflag = '')
    AND (mflag IS NULL OR mflag = '')
  GROUP BY date
),
daily_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    DATE(starttime) as trip_date,
    COUNT(*) as trip_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE DATE(starttime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-12-31'
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    p.date,
    p.precipitation_mm,
    CASE WHEN p.precipitation_mm > 5 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END as weather_condition,
    COALESCE(t.trip_count, 0) as trip_count
  FROM daily_prcp p
  LEFT JOIN daily_trips t ON p.date = t.trip_date
)
SELECT 
  weather_condition,
  COUNT(*) as num_days,
  SUM(trip_count) as total_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(trip_count), COUNT(*)) as avg_daily_trips
FROM combined
GROUP BY weather_condition

-- Final query - clean version with just the required columns
WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT 
    start_station_id as station_id,
    starttime,
    CONCAT(
      CAST(DATE(starttime) AS STRING),
      ' ',
      CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM starttime) AS STRING),
      ':',
      CAST(FLOOR(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM starttime) / 2) * 2 AS STRING)
    ) as two_min_bucket
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
),
group_buckets AS (
  SELECT station_id, two_min_bucket
  FROM same_station_trips
  GROUP BY station_id, two_min_bucket
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
),
group_rides_per_station AS (
  SELECT 
    s.station_id,
    COUNT(*) as group_rides
  FROM same_station_trips s
  INNER JOIN group_buckets g 
    ON s.station_id = g.station_id 
    AND s.two_min_bucket = g.two_min_bucket
  GROUP BY s.station_id
),
total_trips_per_station AS (
  SELECT 
    end_station_id as station_id,
    COUNT(*) as total_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY end_station_id
)
SELECT 
  st.name as station_name,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(g.group_rides, t.total_trips) as proportion
FROM group_rides_per_station g
INNER JOIN total_trips_per_station t
  ON g.station_id = t.station_id
INNER JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_stations` st
  ON CAST(g.station_id AS STRING) = st.station_id
ORDER BY proportion DESC
LIMIT 10

-- The route with the longest average bike duration among those faster than yellow taxis is:
-- 12 Ave & W 40 St -> West St & Chambers St with avg_bike_duration = 1483.91 seconds

-- The question asks for the start station name of this route.
-- Let me verify this is correct by getting just the top one

WITH top_routes AS (
    SELECT 
        start_station_name, 
        end_station_name,
        ROUND(start_station_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(start_station_longitude, 3) as start_lng,
        ROUND(end_station_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(end_station_longitude, 3) as end_lng,
        COUNT(*) as trip_count,
        AVG(tripduration) as avg_bike_duration
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM starttime) = 2016
        AND tripduration > 0
    GROUP BY start_station_name, end_station_name, start_station_latitude, start_station_longitude, end_station_latitude, end_station_longitude
    ORDER BY trip_count DESC
    LIMIT 20
),
taxi_durations AS (
    SELECT 
        ROUND(pickup_latitude, 3) as start_lat,
        ROUND(pickup_longitude, 3) as start_lng,
        ROUND(dropoff_latitude, 3) as end_lat,
        ROUND(dropoff_longitude, 3) as end_lng,
        TIMESTAMP_DIFF(dropoff_datetime, pickup_datetime, SECOND) as duration_seconds
    FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.tlc_yellow_trips_2016`
    WHERE trip_distance > 0
        AND pickup_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_longitude IS NOT NULL
        AND pickup_latitude IS NOT NULL
        AND dropoff_latitude IS NOT NULL
),
taxi_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng,
        AVG(duration_seconds) as avg_taxi_duration
    FROM taxi_durations
    GROUP BY start_lat, start_lng, end_lat, end_lng
)
SELECT 
    tr.start_station_name,
    tr.end_station_name,
    tr.avg_bike_duration,
    ta.avg_taxi_duration
FROM top_routes tr
JOIN taxi_agg ta 
    ON tr.start_lat = ta.start_lat 
    AND tr.start_lng = ta.start_lng
    AND tr.end_lat = ta.end_lat
    AND tr.end_lng = ta.end_lng
WHERE tr.avg_bike_duration < ta.avg_taxi_duration
ORDER BY tr.avg_bike_duration DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  tz.borough AS pickup_borough,
  COUNT(*) AS total_trips,
  SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount = 0 OR SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_tip_trips,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    SUM(CASE WHEN total_amount = 0 OR SAFE_DIVIDE(tip_amount * 100, total_amount) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
    COUNT(*)
  ) * 100 AS no_tip_percentage
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.tlc_yellow_trips_2016` t
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_taxi_trips.taxi_zone_geom` tz
  ON t.pickup_location_id = tz.zone_id
WHERE DATE(t.pickup_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
  AND DATE(t.dropoff_datetime) BETWEEN '2016-01-01' AND '2016-01-07'
  AND t.dropoff_datetime > t.pickup_datetime
  AND t.passenger_count > 0
  AND t.trip_distance >= 0
  AND t.tip_amount >= 0
  AND t.tolls_amount >= 0
  AND t.mta_tax >= 0
  AND t.fare_amount >= 0
  AND t.total_amount >= 0
GROUP BY tz.borough
ORDER BY tz.borough

SELECT s.borough_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id) AS total_stations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN se.entry = TRUE AND se.ada_compliant = TRUE THEN s.station_id END) AS stations_with_ada_entrance,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN se.entry = TRUE AND se.ada_compliant = TRUE THEN s.station_id END), COUNT(DISTINCT s.station_id)) * 100, 2) AS percentage
FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.stations` s
LEFT JOIN `bigquery-public-data.new_york_subway.station_entrances` se 
  ON s.station_name = se.station_name
GROUP BY s.borough_name
ORDER BY percentage DESC

WITH monthly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) AS year_month,
    duration_sec / 60.0 AS duration_min,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date ASC) AS rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY FORMAT_TIMESTAMP('%Y%m', start_date) ORDER BY start_date DESC) AS rn_desc
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco.bikeshare_trips`
)
SELECT 
  year_month,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS first_trip_duration_min,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN duration_min END) AS last_trip_duration_min,
  MAX(duration_min) AS highest_trip_duration_min,
  MIN(duration_min) AS lowest_trip_duration_min
FROM monthly_stats
GROUP BY year_month
ORDER BY year_month

SELECT 
  br.name AS region_name,
  bt.trip_id,
  bt.duration_sec,
  bt.start_date,
  bt.start_station_name,
  bt.member_gender
FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_trips` bt
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` bsi 
  ON CAST(bt.start_station_id AS STRING) = bsi.station_id
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_regions` br ON bsi.region_id = br.region_id
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM bt.start_date) BETWEEN 2014 AND 2017
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY br.region_id ORDER BY bt.start_date DESC) = 1

WITH bike_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as bike_station_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_bikeshare.bikeshare_station_info` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, s.station_geom)
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
),
crime_counts AS (
  SELECT b.neighborhood, COUNT(*) as crime_incident_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_sfpd_incidents.sfpd_incidents` s
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.san_francisco_neighborhoods.boundaries` b
    ON ST_CONTAINS(b.neighborhood_geom, ST_GEOGPOINT(s.longitude, s.latitude))
  GROUP BY b.neighborhood
)
SELECT 
  bc.neighborhood,
  bc.bike_station_count,
  cr.crime_incident_count
FROM bike_counts bc
JOIN crime_counts cr ON bc.neighborhood = cr.neighborhood
ORDER BY bc.neighborhood

SELECT country_name, SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE WHEN age < 25 THEN population ELSE 0 END), SUM(population)) * 100 AS pct_under_25
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.midyear_population_agespecific`
WHERE year = 2017
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY pct_under_25 DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH top_rows AS (
  SELECT 
    country_name,
    cumulative_confirmed,
    COALESCE(cumulative_recovered, 0) as cumulative_recovered,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_name ORDER BY COALESCE(cumulative_confirmed, 0) DESC) as rn
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_open_data.covid19_open_data`
  WHERE date = DATE('2020-05-10') AND aggregation_level = 1
)
SELECT 
  country_name,
  ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(cumulative_recovered, cumulative_confirmed) * 100, 2) as recovery_rate_pct
FROM top_rows
WHERE rn = 1 AND cumulative_confirmed > 50000
ORDER BY recovery_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT 
  (COUNT(DISTINCT v.facility_place_id) * 1000.0) / (SELECT SUM(total_pop) FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_acs.county_2018_5yr` WHERE geo_id LIKE '06%') as vaccine_sites_per_1000
FROM `bigquery-public-data.covid19_vaccination_access.facility_boundary_us_all` v
WHERE v.facility_sub_region_1 = 'California'

SELECT bdr.country_name, bdr.net_migration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.birth_death_growth_rates` bdr
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.census_bureau_international.country_names_area` cna
  ON bdr.country_code = cna.country_code
WHERE bdr.year = 2017
  AND cna.country_area > 500
ORDER BY bdr.net_migration DESC
LIMIT 3

WITH historical AS (
  SELECT
    season,
    'win' AS label,
    win_seed AS seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    lose_seed AS opponent_seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    season,
    'loss' AS label,
    lose_seed AS seed,
    lose_school_ncaa AS school_ncaa,
    win_seed AS opponent_seed,
    win_school_ncaa AS opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.mbb_historical_tournament_games`
  WHERE season >= 2014
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    season,
    label,
    seed,
    school_ncaa,
    opponent_seed,
    opponent_school_ncaa
  FROM `data-to-insights.ncaa.2018_tournament_results`
),
combined AS (
  SELECT
    h.season,
    h.label,
    h.seed,
    h.school_ncaa,
    h.opponent_seed,
    h.opponent_school_ncaa,
    fe.pace_rank AS pace_rank,
    fe.poss_40min AS poss_40min,
    fe.pace_rating AS pace_rating,
    fe.efficiency_rank AS efficiency_rank,
    fe.pts_100poss AS pts_100poss,
    fe.efficiency_rating AS efficiency_rating,
    fe_opp.pace_rank AS opp_pace_rank,
    fe_opp.poss_40min AS opp_poss_40min,
    fe_opp.pace_rating AS opp_pace_rating,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rank AS opp_efficiency_rank,
    fe_opp.pts_100poss AS opp_pts_100poss,
    fe_opp.efficiency_rating AS opp_efficiency_rating
  FROM historical h
  LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe
    ON h.season = fe.season AND h.school_ncaa = fe.team
  LEFT JOIN `data-to-insights.ncaa.feature_engineering` fe_opp
    ON h.season = fe_opp.season AND h.opponent_school_ncaa = fe_opp.team
)
SELECT
  season,
  label,
  seed,
  school_ncaa,
  opponent_seed,
  opponent_school_ncaa,
  pace_rank,
  poss_40min,
  pace_rating,
  efficiency_rank,
  pts_100poss,
  efficiency_rating,
  opp_pace_rank,
  opp_poss_40min,
  opp_pace_rating,
  opp_efficiency_rank,
  opp_pts_100poss,
  opp_efficiency_rating,
  opp_pace_rank - pace_rank AS pace_rank_diff,
  opp_poss_40min - poss_40min AS pace_stat_diff,
  opp_pace_rating - pace_rating AS pace_rating_diff,
  opp_efficiency_rank - efficiency_rank AS eff_rank_diff,
  opp_pts_100poss - pts_100poss AS eff_stat_diff,
  opp_efficiency_rating - efficiency_rating AS eff_rating_diff
FROM combined

WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    workforce,
    report_year,
    race_asian,
    race_black,
    race_hispanic_latinx,
    race_native_american,
    race_white,
    gender_us_women,
    gender_us_men,
    gender_global_women,
    gender_global_men
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_representation`
  WHERE workforce = 'overall'
),
y14 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2014
),
y22 AS (
  SELECT * FROM base WHERE report_year = 2022
)
SELECT 
  'Asian' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y22.race_asian - y14.race_asian) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM y14, y22
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Black' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y22.race_black - y14.race_black) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM y14, y22
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Latinx' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y22.race_hispanic_latinx - y14.race_hispanic_latinx) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM y14, y22
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Native American' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y22.race_native_american - y14.race_native_american) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM y14, y22
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'White' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y22.race_white - y14.race_white) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM y14, y22
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'US women' AS demographic_group,
  ROUND((y22.gender_us_women - y14.gender_us_women) * 100, 1) AS growth_rate_pct_points
FROM y14, y22

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT 
    a.activity_id,
    a.assay_id,
    a.standard_type,
    a.molregno,
    a.standard_value,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.doc_id,
    a.potential_duplicate,
    SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) as heavy_atoms,
    cs.canonical_smiles,
    SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) as pchembl_val
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.activities_29` a
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_properties_29` cp ON a.molregno = cp.molregno
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.compound_structures_29` cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
  WHERE SAFE_CAST(cp.heavy_atoms AS INT64) BETWEEN 10 AND 15
    AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
    AND SAFE_CAST(a.pchembl_value AS FLOAT64) > 10
),
mol_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    assay_id,
    standard_type,
    molregno,
    COUNT(*) as act_count,
    SUM(CAST(potential_duplicate AS INT64)) as dup_count
  FROM qualifying
  GROUP BY assay_id, standard_type, molregno
  HAVING act_count < 5 AND dup_count < 2
),
qual_activities AS (
  SELECT q.*
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN mol_counts mc ON q.assay_id = mc.assay_id 
    AND q.standard_type = mc.standard_type
    AND q.molregno = mc.molregno
),
doc_info AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    journal,
    year,
    first_page,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY journal, SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64) ORDER BY SAFE_CAST(first_page AS INT64)) as pr
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.ebi_chembl.docs_29`
),
doc_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    doc_id,
    COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) as yr,
    GREATEST(1, CAST(FLOOR(pr * 11) AS INT64) + 1) as mo,
    CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pr * 308) AS INT64), 28) AS INT64) + 1 as dy,
    CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(SAFE_CAST(year AS INT64), 1970) AS STRING), '-', 
      LPAD(CAST(GREATEST(1, CAST(FLOOR(pr * 11) AS INT64) + 1) AS STRING), 2, '0'), '-', 
      LPAD(CAST(MOD(CAST(FLOOR(pr * 308) AS INT64), 28) + 1 AS STRING), 2, '0')) as pub_date
  FROM doc_info
),
act_with_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    qa.*,
    dd.yr,
    dd.mo,
    dd.dy,
    dd.pub_date
  FROM qual_activities qa
  LEFT JOIN doc_dates dd ON qa.doc_id = dd.doc_id
),
-- Get distinct pairs
pairs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT 
    q1.assay_id, 
    q1.standard_type, 
    q1.molregno as molregno_1, 
    q2.molregno as molregno_2
  FROM qual_activities q1
  JOIN qual_activities q2 ON q1.assay_id = q2.assay_id 
    AND q1.standard_type = q2.standard_type
    AND q1.molregno < q2.molregno
),
-- For each pair, get the molecule properties
mol_props AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molregno, heavy_atoms, canonical_smiles
  FROM qual_activities
),
-- For each pair, compute the required aggregations
pair_details AS (
  SELECT 
    p.assay_id,
    p.standard_type,
    p.molregno_1,
    p.molregno_2,
    GREATEST(mp1.heavy_atoms, mp2.heavy_atoms) as max_heavy_atoms,
    GREATEST(MAX(ad1.pub_date), MAX(ad2.pub_date)) as latest_pub_date,
    GREATEST(MAX(ad1.doc_id), MAX(ad2.doc_id)) as highest_doc_id,
    MAX(SAFE_CAST(ad1.standard_value AS FLOAT64)) as max_std_val_1,
    MAX(SAFE_CAST(ad2.standard_value AS FLOAT64)) as max_std_val_2,
    mp1.canonical_smiles as smiles_1,
    mp2.canonical_smiles as smiles_2,
    MIN(ad1.activity_id) as act_id_1,
    MIN(ad2.activity_id) as act_id_2
  FROM pairs p
  JOIN mol_props mp1 ON p.molregno_1 = mp1.molregno
  JOIN mol_props mp2 ON p.molregno_2 = mp2.molregno
  JOIN act_with_dates ad1 ON p.molregno_1 = ad1.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = ad1.assay_id AND p.standard_type = ad1.standard_type
  JOIN act_with_dates ad2 ON p.molregno_2 = ad2.molregno 
    AND p.assay_id = ad2.assay_id AND p.standard_type = ad2.standard_type
  GROUP BY p.assay_id, p.standard_type, p.molregno_1, p.molregno_2, mp1.heavy_atoms, mp2.heavy_atoms, mp1.canonical_smiles, mp2.canonical_smiles
)
SELECT 
  pd.max_heavy_atoms,
  pd.latest_pub_date,
  pd.highest_doc_id,
  CASE 
    WHEN pd.max_std_val_1 > pd.max_std_val_2 THEN 'decrease'
    WHEN pd.max_std_val_1 < pd.max_std_val_2 THEN 'increase'
    ELSE 'no-change'
  END as std_change,
  TO_HEX(MD5(TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(pd.act_id_1, pd.act_id_2)))) as mmp_delta_uuid
FROM pair_details pd
ORDER BY pd.assay_id, pd.molregno_1, pd.molregno_2

),
parsed AS (

    SPLIT(page_location, '/') AS segs,
    ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(page_location, '/')) AS seg_count

categories AS (

-- Final answer: cohort with highest 4th-week retention
WITH first_sessions AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    MIN(PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date)) AS first_session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
  GROUP BY user_pseudo_id
),
cohorts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    first_session_date,
    DATE_SUB(first_session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM first_session_date) - 2) DAY) AS cohort_monday
  FROM first_sessions
),
user_sessions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS session_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*` 
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180702' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
user_weeks AS (
  SELECT 
    c.user_pseudo_id,
    c.cohort_monday,
    DATE_DIFF(DATE_SUB(us.session_date, INTERVAL (EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM us.session_date) - 2) DAY), c.cohort_monday, WEEK) AS week_offset
  FROM cohorts c
  JOIN user_sessions us ON c.user_pseudo_id = us.user_pseudo_id
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    cohort_monday,
    user_pseudo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN week_offset = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_week_4
  FROM user_weeks
  GROUP BY cohort_monday, user_pseudo_id
)
SELECT cohort_monday
FROM retention_check
GROUP BY cohort_monday
ORDER BY SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(returned_week_4), COUNT(*)) DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Find users who first engaged with a quickplay event between Aug 1-15
-- and check if they had session_start in week 2 (days 8-14 after first engagement)
WITH quickplay_events AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS event_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_pseudo_id ORDER BY event_date, event_timestamp) AS rn
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20180831'
    AND event_name LIKE '%quickplay%'
),
first_quickplay AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    event_name AS first_quickplay_event,
    event_date AS first_quickplay_date
  FROM quickplay_events
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND event_date BETWEEN '2018-08-01' AND '2018-08-15'
),
session_starts AS (
  SELECT 
    user_pseudo_id,
    PARSE_DATE('%Y%m%d', event_date) AS event_date
  FROM `firebase-public-project.analytics_153293282.events_*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20180801' AND '20181003'
    AND event_name = 'session_start'
),
retention_check AS (
  SELECT 
    fq.first_quickplay_event,
    fq.user_pseudo_id,
    fq.first_quickplay_date,
    CASE WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM session_starts ss
      WHERE ss.user_pseudo_id = fq.user_pseudo_id
        AND ss.event_date > fq.first_quickplay_date + INTERVAL 7 DAY
        AND ss.event_date <= fq.first_quickplay_date + INTERVAL 14 DAY
    ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS retained
  FROM first_quickplay fq
)
SELECT first_quickplay_event, 
       COUNT(*) AS total_users,
       SUM(retained) AS retained_users,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(retained), COUNT(*)) AS retention_rate
FROM retention_check
GROUP BY first_quickplay_event
ORDER BY retention_rate ASC
